Jharkhand Mineral Rights Controversy :jharkhand men khanij sanpda aur uske adhikar ko lekar kendr aur hemant soren sarkar ke bich takrar ka mudda garma gaya hai. rajy ke khanij sansadhnon aur bakaya rashi ko lekar karib 13 hajar karor rupye ka saval charcha men hai. hemant sarkar ne khanij par jharkhand ke adhikar ka mudda uthate hue apna rukh spasht kiya hai.
Aakhir 13 hajar karor rupye ka pura mamla kya hai? khanij sanpda par kendr aur jharkhand sarkar ke bich vivad kyon barh raha hai? kya jharkhand sarkar apne khanij adhikaron ki laraee aur tej karegi?
